original_ai_output.title_zh: 肯尼亚确认首例埃博拉死亡病例，已追踪28名接触者
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 肯尼亚卫生部长周二宣布，该国报告首例埃博拉死亡病例。一名此前居住在刚果（金）的肯尼亚男子返回肯尼亚后死亡，其病毒检测呈阳性。该男子约一个月前发病，曾在刚果（金）接受治疗，后经陆路前往乌干达首都坎帕拉，并于10月3日飞抵内罗毕。目前已追踪到28名接触者。

location.raw_text: Kenya / Democratic Republic of Congo / Kampala / Nairobi

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚报告首例埃博拉死亡病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kenya has reported its first-ever Ebola death, the health minister announced on Tuesday

key_facts.fact: 死者为一名此前居住在刚果（金）的肯尼亚男子，返回肯尼亚后死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: after a Kenyan man who had been living in the Democratic Republic of Congo died after returning to the country

key_facts.fact: 该男子约一个月前发病，曾在刚果（金）接受治疗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The man, who has not been named, fell ill around a month ago and had been treated in the DRC

key_facts.fact: 该男子经陆路前往坎帕拉，于10月3日飞抵内罗毕，检测呈阳性
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: before travelling overland to the Ugandan capital, Kampala, and then flying to Nairobi on October 3. He added that he was screened and confirmed positive for the deadly virus

key_facts.fact: 该男子于前一晚约23时30分死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: regrettably passed on last night at around 1130

uncertainties: 该事件为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
